verses.sloka: एतत् तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा सीता रामस्य दुह्खिता ।प्रसक्त अश्रु मुखी मन्दम् इदम् वचनम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-२९-१॥
verses.transliteration: etat tu vacanam śrutvā sītā rāmasya duhkhitā ।prasakta aśru mukhī mandam idam vacanam abravīt ॥2-29-1॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of Rama, thus spoke Sita in a faint voice in sadness, with tears flowing incessantly from her eyes:
translations.hindi: श्रयोध्याकाएड का तीसवाँ सर्ग समाप्त हुआ । el OT प्र ७ एकात्ररः सगः ---:०:-- एवं श्रुत्वा तु संवादं लक्ष्मण; पूवमागत; | बाष्पपर्याकुल्ुखः शोक सोडुमशवलुवन

verses.sloka: ये त्वया कीर्तिता दोषा वने वस्तव्यताम् प्रति ।गुणान् इति एव तान् विद्धि तव स्नेह पुरः कृतान् ॥२-२९-२॥
verses.transliteration: ye tvayā kīrtitā doṣā vane vastavyatām prati ।guṇān iti eva tān viddhi tava sneha puraḥ kṛtān ॥2-29-2॥

translations.english: Understand that the difficulties of forest life described by you will be turned into advantages if they are accompanied by your affection.

verses.sloka: मृगाः सिम्हा गजाश्चैव शार्दूलाः शरभास्तथा ।पक्षिणः सृमराश्चैव ये चान्ये वनचारिणः ॥२-२९-३॥
verses.transliteration: mṛgāḥ simhā gajāścaiva śārdūlāḥ śarabhāstathā ।pakṣiṇaḥ sṛmarāścaiva ye cānye vanacāriṇaḥ ॥2-29-3॥

translations.english: O scion of the Raghu race antelopes, lions, elephants, tigers, sarabhas, birds, srimaras and other wild beasts wandering in the forest have not seen your beauty before. Now on seeing you, they will flee away. In fact, who will not be afraid of seeing an object of fear?.

verses.sloka: अदृष्टपूर्वरूपत्वात्सर्वे ते तव राघव ।रूपम् दृष्ट्वापसर्पेयुर्भये सर्वे हि बिभ्यति ॥२-२९-४॥
verses.transliteration: adṛṣṭapūrvarūpatvātsarve te tava rāghava ।rūpam dṛṣṭvāpasarpeyurbhaye sarve hi bibhyati ॥2-29-4॥

translations.english: O scion of the Raghu race antelopes, lions, elephants, tigers, sarabhas, birds, srimaras and other wild beasts wandering in the forest have not seen your beauty before. Now on seeing you, they will flee away. In fact, who will not be afraid of seeing an object of fear?.

verses.sloka: त्वया च सह गन्तव्यम् मया गुरु जन आज्ञया ।त्वद् वियोगेन मे राम त्यक्तव्यम् इह जीवितम् ॥२-२९-५॥
verses.transliteration: tvayā ca saha gantavyam mayā guru jana ājñayā ।tvad viyogena me rāma tyaktavyam iha jīvitam ॥2-29-5॥

translations.english: In accordance with the command of the elders, I must accompany you to the forest. If I am separated from you, I will give up my life here itself.

verses.sloka: न च माम् त्वत् समीपस्थम् अपि शक्नोति राघव ।सुराणाम् ईश्वरः शक्रः प्रधर्षयितुम् ओजसा ॥२-२९-६॥
verses.transliteration: na ca mām tvat samīpastham api śaknoti rāghava ।surāṇām īśvaraḥ śakraḥ pradharṣayitum ojasā ॥2-29-6॥

translations.english: If I am in your company, O Rama even the lord of the gods, Indra with all his might will not be able to hurt me.

verses.sloka: पति हीना तु या नारी न सा शक्ष्यति जीवितुम् ।कामम् एवम् विधम् राम त्वया मम विदर्शितम् ॥२-२९-७॥
verses.transliteration: pati hīnā tu yā nārī na sā śakṣyati jīvitum ।kāmam evam vidham rāma tvayā mama vidarśitam ॥2-29-7॥

translations.english: Your salutary instruction to me, O Rama, is 'A woman cannot live without her husband'. This truth is greatly applicable to me.

verses.sloka: अथ च अपि महा प्राज्ञ ब्राह्मणानाम् मया श्रुतम् ।पुरा पितृ गृहे सत्यम् वस्तव्यम् किल मे वने ॥२-२९-८॥
verses.transliteration: atha ca api mahā prājña brāhmaṇānām mayā śrutam ।purā pitṛ gṛhe satyam vastavyam kila me vane ॥2-29-8॥

translations.english: O highly sagacious Rama I had also heard in my father's house long ago, from brahmins prophesing that some day I shall have certainly to dwell in the forest.

verses.sloka: लक्षणिभ्यो द्विजातिभ्यः श्रुत्वा अहम् वचनम् गृहे ।वन वास कृत उत्साहा नित्यम् एव महा बल ॥२-२९-९॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣaṇibhyo dvijātibhyaḥ śrutvā aham vacanam gṛhe ।vana vāsa kṛta utsāhā nityam eva mahā bala ॥2-29-9॥

translations.english: O mighty hero ever since I heard the prophesies from the brahmin palmists I am yearning to dwell in the forest.

verses.sloka: आदेशो वन वासस्य प्राप्तव्यः स मया किल ।सा त्वया सह तत्र अहम् यास्यामि प्रिय न अन्यथा ॥२-२९-१०॥
verses.transliteration: ādeśo vana vāsasya prāptavyaḥ sa mayā kila ।sā tvayā saha tatra aham yāsyāmi priya na anyathā ॥2-29-10॥

translations.english: Therefore, O my beloved I must certainly obtain such a command to dwell in the forest. I must accompany you to the forest and it cannot be otherwise.

verses.sloka: कृत आदेशा भविष्यामि गमिष्यामि सह त्वया ।कालः च अयम् समुत्पन्नः सत्य वाग् भवतु द्विजः ॥२-२९-११॥
verses.transliteration: kṛta ādeśā bhaviṣyāmi gamiṣyāmi saha tvayā ।kālaḥ ca ayam samutpannaḥ satya vāg bhavatu dvijaḥ ॥2-29-11॥

translations.english: I will go with you, true to the prediction of the brahmin. That time has come and let his prediction come to pass.

verses.sloka: वन वासे हि जानामि दुह्खानि बहुधा किल ।प्राप्यन्ते नियतम् वीर पुरुषैः अकृत आत्मभिः ॥२-२९-१२॥
verses.transliteration: vana vāse hi jānāmi duhkhāni bahudhā kila ।prāpyante niyatam vīra puruṣaiḥ akṛta ātmabhiḥ ॥2-29-12॥

translations.english: I am aware, O valiant one, that there are hardships of every kind in forest life. But they befall those whose senses are not under their control.

verses.sloka: कन्यया च पितुर् गेहे वन वासः श्रुतः मयाभिक्षिण्याः साधु वृत्ताया मम मातुर् इह अग्रतः ॥२-२९-१३॥
verses.transliteration: kanyayā ca pitur gehe vana vāsaḥ śrutaḥ mayābhikṣiṇyāḥ sādhu vṛttāyā mama mātur iha agrataḥ ॥2-29-13॥

translations.english: When I was young in my father's house, a holy female mendicant foretold in the presence of my mother that I would dwell in the forest (in this life).

verses.sloka: प्रसादितः च वै पूर्वम् त्वम् वै बहु विधम् प्रभो ।गमनम् वन वासस्य कान्क्षितम् हि सह त्वया ॥२-२९-१४॥
verses.transliteration: prasāditaḥ ca vai pūrvam tvam vai bahu vidham prabho ।gamanam vana vāsasya kānkṣitam hi saha tvayā ॥2-29-14॥

translations.english: Pleased with my long entreaties in the past to dwell with you in the forest, O lord, you had granted my desire.

verses.sloka: कृत क्षणा अहम् भद्रम् ते गमनम् प्रति राघव ।वन वासस्य शूरस्य चर्या हि मम रोचते ॥२-२९-१५॥
verses.transliteration: kṛta kṣaṇā aham bhadram te gamanam prati rāghava ।vana vāsasya śūrasya caryā hi mama rocate ॥2-29-15॥

translations.english: Since then I have been counting time for this forest life. It pleases me to follow my valiant hero as he lives in the forest. Rama, prosperity to you

verses.sloka: शुद्ध आत्मन् प्रेम भावाद्द् हि भविष्यामि विकल्मषा ।भर्तारम् अनुगच्चन्ती भर्ता हि मम दैवतम् ॥२-२९-१६॥
verses.transliteration: śuddha ātman prema bhāvādd hi bhaviṣyāmi vikalmaṣā ।bhartāram anugaccantī bhartā hi mama daivatam ॥2-29-16॥

translations.english: O my purehearted one by following my husband with love I shall become sinless, because my husband is my god.

verses.sloka: प्रेत्य भावे अपि कल्याणः सम्गमः मे सह त्वया ।श्रुतिर् हि श्रूयते पुण्या ब्राह्मणानाम् यशस्विनाम् ॥२-२९-१७॥
verses.transliteration: pretya bhāve api kalyāṇaḥ samgamaḥ me saha tvayā ।śrutir hi śrūyate puṇyā brāhmaṇānām yaśasvinām ॥2-29-17॥

translations.english: My union with you, O highminded one, is auspicious even beyond death. A woman, given away by her parents in accordance with traditional offerings of water belongs to him even after death and lives with him. This is a statement from the Vedas quoted by famous brahmins.

verses.sloka: इह लोके च पितृभिर् या स्त्री यस्य महा मते ।अद्भिर् दत्ता स्वधर्मेण प्रेत्य भावे अपि तस्य सा ॥२-२९-१८॥
verses.transliteration: iha loke ca pitṛbhir yā strī yasya mahā mate ।adbhir dattā svadharmeṇa pretya bhāve api tasya sā ॥2-29-18॥

translations.english: My union with you, O highminded one, is auspicious even beyond death. A woman, given away by her parents in accordance with traditional offerings of water belongs to him even after death and lives with him. This is a statement from the Vedas quoted by famous brahmins.

verses.sloka: एवम् अस्मात् स्वकाम् नारीम् सुवृत्ताम् हि पति व्रताम् ।न अभिरोचयसे नेतुम् त्वम् माम् केन इह हेतुना ॥२-२९-१९॥
verses.transliteration: evam asmāt svakām nārīm suvṛttām hi pati vratām ।na abhirocayase netum tvam mām kena iha hetunā ॥2-29-19॥

translations.english: Why don't you want to take to the forest your own wife who is loyal and devoted, and is of good conduct.

verses.sloka: भक्ताम् पति व्रताम् दीनाम् माम् समाम् सुख दुह्खयोह् ।नेतुम् अर्हसि काकुत्स्थ समान सुख दुह्खिनीम् ॥२-२९-२०॥
verses.transliteration: bhaktām pati vratām dīnām mām samām sukha duhkhayoh ।netum arhasi kākutstha samāna sukha duhkhinīm ॥2-29-20॥

translations.english: O Rama, I am faithful and devoted to you. I have equal disposition to happiness and sorrow. I equally share your prosperity and adversity. Therefore, you should take your wife (to the forest). In this time of distress.

verses.sloka: यदि माम् दुह्खिताम् एवम् वनम् नेतुम् न च इच्चसि ।विषम् अग्निम् जलम् वा अहम् आस्थास्ये मृत्यु कारणात् ॥२-२९-२१॥
verses.transliteration: yadi mām duhkhitām evam vanam netum na ca iccasi ।viṣam agnim jalam vā aham āsthāsye mṛtyu kāraṇāt ॥2-29-21॥

translations.english: If you do not wish to take your wife in this time of distress to the forest I shall die by consuming poison or throwing myself into fire or drowning in water.

verses.sloka: एवम् बहु विधम् तम् सा याचते गमनम् प्रति ।न अनुमेने महा बाहुस् ताम् नेतुम् विजनम् वनम् ॥२-२९-२२॥
verses.transliteration: evam bahu vidham tam sā yācate gamanam prati ।na anumene mahā bāhus tām netum vijanam vanam ॥2-29-22॥

translations.english: Despite Sita's pleadings with him in various ways the mightyarmed Rama would not consent to take her to the desolate forest.

verses.sloka: एवम् उक्ता तु सा चिन्ताम् मैथिली समुपागता ।स्नापयन्ती इव गाम् उष्णैः अश्रुभिर् नयन च्युतैः ॥२-२९-२३॥
verses.transliteration: evam uktā tu sā cintām maithilī samupāgatā ।snāpayantī iva gām uṣṇaiḥ aśrubhir nayana cyutaiḥ ॥2-29-23॥

translations.english: Thus spoken to (prevented), Sita was filled with grief and cried, drenching the ground with warm tears that fell from her eyes.

verses.sloka: चिन्तयन्तीम् तथा ताम् तु निवर्तयितुम् आत्मवान् ।ताम्रोष्ठीं स तदा सीताम् काकुत्स्थो बह्व् असान्त्वयत् ॥२-२९-२४॥
verses.transliteration: cintayantīm tathā tām tu nivartayitum ātmavān ।tāmroṣṭhīṁ sa tadā sītām kākutstho bahv asāntvayat ॥2-29-24॥

translations.english: That selfpossessed scion of the Kakutstha dynasty consoled the copperredlipped Sita in several ways to dissuade her (from going to the forest). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकोनत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyninth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
